name: 10pines-c6-tuslibros-iteracion4
title: TusLibros Iteration 4: System Facade, Sessions and Time
description: Fourth iteration of TusLibros.com: an object facade offering the five operations of the statement as messages, with clientId/password authentication, cart ids, cart sessions that expire 30 minutes after their last use, a clock the tests replace with a manual one, tickets with line items and purchases per client. The code of iterations 1 to 3 is given. The string encoding, HTTP and batch files are not part of the course material.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: Time has to be injected so the tests can move a manual clock past 30 minutes deterministically; the facade keeps sessions by id, authenticates clients and aggregates purchases from the sales book while staying on the inner side of the interface.
